contentItem.title: 性质与证明：整数
contentItem.englishTitle: If a number be a part of a number, and another be the same part of another, alternately also, whatever part or parts the first is of the third, the same part, or the same parts, will the second also be of the fourth.

surfaces.text: If a number be a part of a number, and another be the same part of another, alternately also, whatever part or parts the first is of the third, the same part, or the same parts, will the second also be of the fourth.
如果一个数字是数字的一部分,另一个数字是数字的同一部分,则无论第一个或几个部分是第三个,第二个数字也是第四个。

For let the number A be a part of the number BC, and another, D, the same part of another, EF, that A is of BC; I say that, alternately also, whatever part or parts A is of D, the same part or parts is BC of EF also.
A数字应该成为BC数字的一部分,另外D数字,EF数字的同一部分,A数字是BC数字;我说,无论A数字的某一部分或某一部分是D数字,同样部分或某一部分也是EF数字的BC数字。
For since, whatever part A is of BC, the same part also is D of EF, therefore, as many numbers as there are in BC equal to A, so many also are there in EF equal to D.
因为,无论第A部分是BC部分,EF份中也有D份,因此,BC份中的数字等于A份,EF份中的数字等于D份。
Let BC be divided into the numbers equal to A, namely BG, GC, and EF into those equal to D, namely EH, HF; thus the multitude of BG, GC will be equal to the multitude of EH, HF.
让BC分为A,即BG、GC和EF,即D,即EH、HF;因此,BG、GC将等于EH、HF。

Now, since the numbers BG, GC are equal to one another, and the numbers EH, HF are also equal to one another, while the multitude of BG, GC is equal to the multitude of EH, HF, therefore, whatever part or parts BG is of EH, the same part or the same parts is GC of HF also; so that, in addition, whatever part or parts BG is of EH, the same part also, or the same parts, is the sum BC of the sum EF. [[VII. 5, 6](/principles/euclid-7-5)]
现在,由于BG,GC数字是等同的,EH,HF数字也是等同的,而BG,GC数字是EH,HF数字是等同的,因此,无论BG部分或BG部分是EH,GC部分还是HF,GC部分是同一部分或同一部分,因此,此外,BG部分或同一部分是EH,EF总数中的BC。 [[VII. 5, 6](/principles/euclid-7-5)]
But BG is equal to A, and EH to D; therefore, whatever part or parts A is of D, the same part or the same parts is BC of EF also. Q. E. D.
但BG等于A,EH至D;因此,无论A部分或部分为D,同一部分或相同部分为EF,Q,E。（相关点与线段：BC）
